```yaml
name: Update Roadmap on Merge

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [closed]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  update-roadmap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.pull_request.merged == true)"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Generate roadmap
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const path = 'ROADMAP.md';

            // Fetch recent merged PRs
            const { data: prs } = await github.paginate(github.rest.pulls.list, {
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'closed',
              sort: 'updated',
              direction: 'desc',
              per_page: 100
            });
            const merged = prs.filter(pr => pr.merged_at).slice(0, 10);
            const list = merged.map(pr => `- #${pr.number}`).join('\n');

            // Static roadmap content with dynamic PR list
            const content = `# Sourcebot Roadmap 🚀

Hello 👋 We want to be transparent on what we're working on and what's next. This roadmap is a **living document** that we will update as we make progress. Items prefixed with \`[EE]\` are features that we plan to place into the [enterprise offering](https://www.sourcebot.dev/pricing). All other items are planned to be in core and [licensed under FSL](https://github.com/sourcebot-dev/sourcebot/blob/main/LICENSE.md#functional-source-license-version-11-alv2-future-license).

> \[!NOTE\]
> **Your feedback is valuable to us**. Is there something missing? Please submit a [feature request](https://github.com/sourcebot-dev/sourcebot/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) or thumbs up 👍 existing ones. Also feel free to comment directly on this issue. Knowing what is important to you helps us prioritize what to work on and improve Sourcebot for everyone.

## 🚀 Released

10 most recent [merged PRs](https://github.com/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged):

${list}

## 🔮 Planned

> \[!IMPORTANT\]
> Some of these items do not have issues. We're working on it 👷‍♂️🚧

### Code Search

* Unlimited branch support (#461)
* Zoekt search limit warning (#504)

### Ask SB

* 3rd party MCP server support
* Mermaid diagram support
* Automated eval test suite
* Integrated AI chat thread panel while browsing code (#476)

### Misc

* Inline git blame in code editor
* Branch / commit selector in \`/browse\`
* Sourcebot CLI
* \[EE\] Batch changes ([#403](https://github.com/sourcebot-dev/sourcebot/issues/403))
* Improved production deployment support (#439)
* Easier access to file explorer (#472)
* Universal fuzzy search (#536)
`;

            fs.writeFileSync(path, content);
            console.log('Roadmap updated.');

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add ROADMAP.md
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "Update roadmap with latest merged PRs"
            git push
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
